title: Timothy, a Christian Scientist teacher, on what music is
summary: Hinton recalls reading Thomas's books; Thomas says Timothy taught that music is melody, harmony and rhythm and that discord is not music.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Now, you mentioned... And I happen to know because of how long we've been friends, and I've been following you (?) because I worship you, and you've been so much of an important part of my life. When you got into Christian Science, I tried very hard. You had your books, and I read your books -- I tried to read everything that you
gave me to read. And you told that you went to study with Timothy, which was also a Christian Scientist.

Yeah, and he was a Christian Scientist. So we got along so beautiful, you know. And everything he told me, I tried it out. And I had been doing a lot of these things on my own, but I didn't understand them. Now, see, one of the principal things that Timothy taught me was what music was.
Music is melody, harmony and rhythm. It takes them three things to make music. And Christian Science tells you that discord is not music.
I see. I'll challenge you on that later.
